codigoBarras.description: Optional retail/logistics barcode for seller scan (#255).

controlLote.description: When true, stock movements require lot tracking / FEFO (#202).

esPsicotropico.description: Pharmacy vertical — tracked in the internal psychotropic book (#204); not a SEDRONAR filing.

factorConversion.description: 1 purchase unit equals factorConversion base units (#203). Default 1.

mesesGarantia.description: Warranty months for physical articles; null = no warranty (#251).

minimo.description: Minimum stock in base units; Decimal(14,4) (#203).

multiploVenta.description: Optional sale multiple for cut-to-size items (#203).

pesoKg.description: Unit weight in kg for logistics (#203).

requiereReceta.description: Pharmacy vertical — dispensing requires a registered prescription (#204).

stock.description: Stock quantity in base units; Decimal(14,4) (#203).

unidadBase.description: Base stock/sale unit catalog (#203). Default unidad.

unidadCompra.description: Purchase unit when different from base (#203).

urlThumb.description: Principal thumbnail public path (`/uploads/articulos/...`) for seller catalog grid (#257). Null when the article has no image.

volumenM3.description: Unit volume in m3 for logistics (#203).
